Voice Commands Guide

▾
  • "Stop" / "Pause" - Pause dictation instantly
  • "Continue" / "Resume" / "Go" - Resume speaking
  • "Spell" / "Spell word" - Spell word letter by letter
  • "Repeat" - Repeat current word
  • "Go Back" / "Back 4 words" - Rewind words
  • "2x" / "Double Speed" - Double current speed
  • "Normal" / "Normal Speed" - Reset to 1x speed
  • "Slower" / "Faster" - Fine-tune WPM speed
